description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [Imperil Earth 20% (15s)], grants [Buff Earth 20% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Dorgann], [Warriors of Dawn Damage Tracker] and [Warriors of Dawn Level] to the user

description.name: Buff Earth 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Earth damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Dorgann
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Warriors of Dawn (0~2), removed after using Warriors of Dawn two times

description.name: Warriors of Dawn Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Warriors of Dawn level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Dorgann]

description.name: Warriors of Dawn Level
description.text: Keeps track of Warriors of Dawn level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Dorgann]
